atoms.direct_criterion: Recover the exact supported full-case predicate from the manifest and supplied build/support policy without adding rejected selector classes.
Partition the raw selector domain exhaustively into every accepted, explicitly rejected, and non-Unicode class present in the source/policy.
Recover the literal claim-relevant operation order, including every output attempt, branch, panic, return, and possible partial prefix.
Derive the complete selector match input and match selection for every raw selector class from exact String::as_str, Result, pattern, and match semantics rather than inspected syntax alone.
Close the tail-expression, omitted-output, function-body, and normal-return semantic edges on every successful script path.
Derive complete successful and unsuccessful ordered traces, including stdout failures, partial emitted prefixes, and exits before later operations.
Apply only the exact accepted Cargo/build TCB to map successful current outputs to cfg-selected library source and prove failed executions produce no current compilation.
Prove the requested rerun/freshness sequence and reject stale-artifact reasoning using only the accepted invalidation premise.
Prove the supported exclusion and composite-cfg source partition over every relevant feature/target/selector case.
From the exact ordinary public fn declaration and accepted source/configuration selection, establish an exact valid safe use and its input domain.
From the exact typed source and u8 domain, establish zero, explicit-return transfer, reachability, false unsafe precondition, applicable UB, and the scoped verdict.

Give the correct aggregate postcondition disposition and make no false regional or whole-domain assertion; a voluntary regional claim must prove its stated boundary, but no maximal region or detailed region output is required.
Reconcile every consumed Rust semantic edge and every build-tool premise to narrow Rust 1.85.1 authority or the exact accepted TCB, without widening either.
